meta.title: Konbini Taste Test | Kenji Eats Japan
meta.description:
Konbini are the cornerstones (literally!) of the convenient food culture in Japan. It's time to put the big three—7-Eleven, FamilyMart, and Lawson—to the test!

Curious to learn more about konbini? Check out the free article on my Patreon diving in to these iconic shops: https://www.patreon.com/kenjilopezalt/posts/166489321

Looking to make a konbini-style egg salad sando at home? Unlock the recipe here: https://frienji.kenjilopezalt.com/posts/konbini-style-166707773

Kenji Eats Japan is a summer-long series inspired by my travels through Japan in April of this year. Super Frienjis on my Patreon enjoy exclusive access to written recipes from this series. Free Frienjis can enjoy accompanying articles and watch videos ad-free. Join us: https://frienji.kenjilopezalt.com/posts/introducing-eats-162823119

Watch the full series: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLKVyj94PRGeg&si=TlmbeVSLtjM8pR1U
